acceptance_tests.name: generated ledgers match the release
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: ok is true and errors is empty; both generated ledger digests equal TARGET-RELEASE.json ledgers[*].sha256

acceptance_tests.name: triage covers the residue exactly
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: ok is true; every one of the 11,546 residue identities appears exactly once with a terminal triage state and no carried state

acceptance_tests.name: release stays lossless and green
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: ok is true and errors is empty

adversarial.expectation: a triage run that outputs fewer than 11,546 rows, or any row with a carried state, fails the acceptance test
any diff touching qamus/schemas/largelexicon-* fails the packet
committing a full ledger or full triage JSONL into a tracked path fails the packet
a tampered generated ledger is rejected by --validate-generated-ledgers before triage begins

positive.expectation: a lemma-source identity quarantined only for root_shape_or_reason, whose entry already records an authored root, triages to repair_proposed with the exact source locator
a crosswalk identity flagged for additional_property review_fact_id triages to owner_schema_decision_required and names the payload field

candidate_population.population_source: out/largelexicon-target-schema/{quarantined,flagged}-identities.jsonl, regenerated by tools/promote_largelexicon_target_schema.py --write and hash-verified against TARGET-RELEASE.json ledgers[*].sha256
candidate_population.selection_rule: every identity in the regenerated quarantined ledger (10,067) and flagged ledger (1,479); the carried 241,746 are out of scope. The tracked bounded samples are for review only and are never the population.

commands.purpose: invoke the committed generator so the FULL 11,546-row residue ledgers exist under gitignored out/
verify the generated full-output hashes against TARGET-RELEASE.json before reading a single row
re-prove the release is lossless, validation-green and byte-deterministic
prove the triage output covers the generated residue exactly, once it has been written

defeaters: a proposed repair that would change a committed @1 row in place
a proposed schema relaxation that would let the legacy payload pass the target row schema
a triage row whose identity does not resolve in the residue ledger
a triage row that asserts a root without an authored source
a triage run that reads a tracked bounded sample as if it were the full population
a triage run whose generated ledger hashes disagree with TARGET-RELEASE.json
definition_of_done: every one of the 11,546 residue identities carries exactly one terminal triage state
no committed @1 table byte and no target schema byte changed
the target release remains lossless with zero silent drops and zero validation violations
each non-terminal identity has an exact follow-on packet or blocker row, never a vague note
the full triage output stayed under gitignored out/ and only a bounded sample plus hash-bound metadata was committed

conditions: a residue identity requires a target-schema change to resolve
a root or surface repair requires a scholar-level judgement
the flagged crosswalk payload has no correct home outside the row
escalation_trigger.route: owner packet for the schema question; sarf authoring lane for root/surface repairs; docs/blockers.yaml for anything neither can close

evidence_policy.fabrication_rule: If the correct root, surface or schema disposition is not derivable from committed repository artifacts, emit source_gap with the precise question. Never invent a root for a resemblance and never guess a surface split.
evidence_policy.statement: Each triage row cites the residue ledger row (family, identity, source_locator, source_row_sha256) read from the hash-verified generated ledger, and the defect family that quarantined or flagged it. No triage row may assert a linguistic conclusion; a root or surface repair is a proposal for the authoring lane, not a certification.

expected_outputs.description: FULL triage output, one row per residue identity with a terminal triage state and the exact next action; regenerable, kept under gitignored out/
bounded deterministic sample of the triage output (first rows per family in canonical order)
generator, counts per triage state, the full-output sha256, the bounded-sample sha256, and the TARGET-RELEASE ledger digests the triage was computed against

guards: the METHOD of this triage transfers to later migration residue; the linguistic conclusions inside any single row never transfer to another row
risk_flags quarantine means the source row already carries a recorded risk; clearing it requires repairing the source row, not deleting the flag
root_shape_or_reason quarantine is a source-data question: a malformed root needs an authored repair or an explicit no_root_reason, never a normalization guess
the 1,479 flagged crosswalk rows carry review_fact_id / rebind_provenance / demotion payloads: routing them needs an owner schema decision about where that payload belongs, not a silent drop
no triage state may be recorded as carried; only tools/promote_largelexicon_target_schema.py assigns dispositions

the full ledgers and the full triage output are regenerable artifacts under gitignored out/: only bounded samples plus hash-bound metadata may be committed, and the generated hashes must match TARGET-RELEASE.json before any row is read

non_deployment.statement: This packet produces candidate triage rows and repair proposals only. Nothing here reaches a learner surface, mutates the live site, or certifies a linguistic fact; applying any proposed repair is a separate owner-gated authoring step.

out_of_scope: editing any committed @1 table: they are immutable migration inputs
editing any qamus/schemas/largelexicon-* target schema: weakening a schema to accept legacy output is forbidden
certifying any lexical, morphological or grammatical fact
promoting a quarantined identity to carried without repairing its underlying source row
committing any full ledger or full triage output into a tracked path: they are regenerable outputs under gitignored out/
scope.summary: The v1 to target-schema promotion carried 241,746 of 253,292 source rows. The remaining 11,546 identities are recorded, never dropped: 10,067 quarantined for semantic reasons (risk_flags, root_shape_or_reason) and 1,479 flagged for a structural blocker (crosswalk rows carrying review_fact_id / rebind_provenance / demotion, which the target row schema forbids). The FULL ledgers are large regenerable outputs: only bounded deterministic samples plus hash-bound metadata are tracked, and the complete ledgers must be regenerated into the gitignored out/ tree before triage. This packet dispositions those identities into repair, schema-decision, or accepted-gap states. It changes no committed v1 row and no target schema.

title: Triage the 10,067 quarantined and 1,479 flagged largelexicon identities left by the target-schema promotion
